:= by
  have := ProbabilityTheory.isGaussian_has_density μ
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := this
  have h_f : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ≠ 0 := by
    intro x
    contrapose! h
    rw [MeasureTheory.ae_eq_iff]
    exact (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_dirac μ h).ae_ne_zero
  have h_integrable := MeasureTheory.has_density_integrable f hf
  have h_ae_eq := MeasureTheory.has_density_ae f hf
  have h_ae_zero := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.NullSingletonClass.ae_zero]
    exact h_ae_eq
  have h_null_singleton := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.NullSingletonClass.def]
    intro x
    intro h_x
    have := h_ae_zero
    exact h_x
  exact h_null_singleton
